Name: Nyagi Sheep
Author: MicomiBite
Description:
[b]After the endless teasing following the creation of the Nyagi sheep, I made it my mission to bring it to life within Stardew Valley.[/b]

For context, this mod is based on the streamer [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nyagi_byte]Nyagi_Byte[/url] (I'm also the artist of her character!), whom I adore with all my heart.

So, this mod is more of a silly little gift for her community, but feel free to download if you just want cute looking demon sheep frolicking around your farm!

♡
